capabilities: Format selected lines into paired hemistiches with a central gap
Format selected lines into an indented second-hemistich layout
Adjust gap and indent widths per mode
Set a default action for the ribbon icon
Trigger formatting from command palette, context menu, or ribbon
extras: Works entirely offline with no accounts, payments, or telemetry; states each hemistich must be on its own line before formatting.
problem: Obsidian's editor leaves Arabic poetry as one hemistich per line, with no way to align verse halves for readable classical layouts.
summary: Formatting plugin that converts selected Arabic poetry lines into paired hemistiches on one line or an indented two-line layout.
